title: Direct air capture
description: Take CO₂ out of the air with machines and store it underground. This lever follows its own timing, separate from the shared one. The electricity the machines use counts.

directAirCapture.title: Direct air capture
directAirCapture.description: Plants take CO₂ from the air and store it underground. At 100%, they follow the IEA's path: about 0.65 Gt a year in 2050 and 3.3 Gt in 2100. The CO₂ of the plants' electricity counts, and renewable electricity lowers it.
